dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region contains several prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with jagged, high-contrast perimeters. These structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from a low-intensity (dark) exterior to a high-intensity, speckled (light) interior, particularly visible in the central-lateral clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the lower-ventral margin and near the posterior transition, where specular reflections create localized areas of peak intensity without an internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest closed 'O' structures on the dorsal-lateral flank form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral, with the longest axis oriented longitudinally along the body curvature.
